verdict.rationale: Evidence shows New Relic ships an official MCP server so external AI tools can connect to New Relic's data (new-relic-docs-11, new-relic-docs-22, new-relic-probe-3) — this is the reverse direction (New Relic as MCP server, not MCP client). No evidence indicates New Relic's own AI assistant or platform can consume/plug in external MCP servers to use their tools.
